cli.date: YYYY-MM-DD disclosure date, mutually exclusive with range
cli.start-date/end-date: both required for a range, start <= end
cli.cursor: events-only opaque startId; exactly one category for resume
cli.max-pages: optional positive caller bound per category; incomplete if more possible
cli.country-codes: statistics or economic_indicator events only; source IDs such as USA. In mixed events applies only to economic_indicator.
cli.event-id: backtest only, exact earning_ uniqueId from source events
cli.symbols: recommendations only, tickers as context from the selected event list
cli.source-input: raw API envelope(s) or raw event array, one category per offline file; coverage unknown
cli.event-type: events only: one or more of earning economic_indicator dividend stock_split ipo holiday; default earning

dataContract.events: Common id,eventType,eventDate,symbol,marketId,name,raw; earning retains original EPS/revenue fields. Other categories preserve non-null source objects in details. Economic events additionally name,country,releaseTime,releaseTimezone(null),periodEnd,frequency,importance,indicatorId,actual/forecast/prior numeric nullable and corresponding Raw strings.
dataContract.pagination: complete, stoppedBecause, nextCursor, pages, resumedFromCursor; complete means requested traversal completed, not verified market-wide universe
dataContract.source: fixed API URL, requested parameters, actual transport and request interval; offline fetch times null
dataContract.backtest/recommendations: raw data, optional; internal nested schema/methodology not asserted
dataContract.units: source numeric strings parsed without percentage scaling or revenue B/M conversion; currency and time-type enum not invented
dataContract.missing: null, not zero; no fabricated surprise fields
dataContract.backtest: data.backtest[].backtest_result.visual.value.datas[].backtest_result.target_result has targetEventTimes and stockEventData[] with dayIndex,winRate,averageYield,positiveDays; data.periods holds EPS actual/estimate history. Raw data preserved; summary omits large price arrays.
dataContract.categoryResults: Live events: per-category eventType, parameters, eventCount, pagination and optional errorType. Combined complete is true only if all requested categories completed. Failed categories differ from successful empty lists. Each cursor is category-bound.

presentation.contract: JSON data only; agent selects appropriate explanation or visualization

security: Fixed read-only GET resources after one standard ephemeral AInvest visitor session POST; credentials in memory only, no personal login/account/watchlist input, retry or synthetic fallback.

authenticationStatus.visitor: All six category GETs verified with standard visitor transport; 2026-11-02 nonempty economic/dividend/IPO and prior earnings, empty stock_split/holiday. Backtest remains earnings-only.

agentContract.capability: data-only; choose operations by question scope, not keyword routing

coverage.naturalRequests: Economic releases, company earnings, dividends, stock splits, IPOs and holidays, including combined daily/weekly schedules. User need not name AInvest.
coverage.categories: events --event-type earning economic_indicator dividend stock_split ipo holiday; choose the required subset. Default remains earning for compatibility.
coverage.countries: --country-codes source IDs e.g. USA is supported for economic_indicator events and statistics. In mixed queries other categories are unfiltered, not an assumed US-only universe. Omitted countryCodes uses provider defaults, not verified global coverage; inspect summary.returnedEconomicCountries and pass explicit source country IDs for the requested scope.
coverage.dates: State calendar-date scope and basis. releaseTime preserves source publicTime; UI labels ET but API lacks timezone/offset. releaseTimezone null: verify before converting. Earnings disclosureTimeType enum is still not fully verified.
coverage.sourceStatus: Per-event actual/forecast/prior nulls preserved. Empty successful category and failed/incomplete category must be distinguished. Source traversal completion is not a market-wide completeness guarantee.

operations.events: Economic/earnings/dividend/split/IPO/holiday event lists by --date D or --start-date A --end-date B; --event-type accepts multiple categories. Economic values are nullable, country/time/period remain explicit; use --country-codes USA only for economic events. Each category independently paginated.
operations.backtest: Existing provider historical beat/miss win rates and returns, NOT only the selected event outcome. --operation backtest --event-id <source uniqueId> --output <JSON>. One event identity anchors a historical sample snapshot: it is not necessary to collect every historical earnings date. Obtain an appropriate source ID from available earnings-calendar observations; never fabricate it.
operations.statistics: Daily counts of calendar categories. --start-date A --end-date B, optional --country-codes source IDs.
operations.recommendations: Optional suggested questions, not numerical evidence.

agentContract.selection: For general historical post-earnings behavior, the provider backtest may directly cover the question. For user-defined horizons, sample periods, entry/exit or costs that differ from the source, choose independent calculation and explain the method. Agent remains free to combine or reject capabilities.
agentContract.handoff: backtest summary exposes sample counts, source periods and windows(dayIndex,winRate,averageYield,positiveDays). data retains full source backtest and periods (EPS actual/estimate history). Reuse these files instead of fetching price history merely to recreate already-available source statistics.
agentContract.units: winRate is 0..1; averageYield already percent; sourceTag probability value already percent. Source prose is unverified and may contradict structured numbers.

purpose: Structured AInvest economic releases, earnings, dividends, splits, IPO and holiday events; natural queries need not name AInvest. Optional earnings-only historical backtests.
